description: Defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing and manipulating news resource data in a Room database, including queries for fetching, inserting, updating, and deleting news resources and related cross-reference entities.

classes.name: NewsResourceDao
classes.description: Interface providing database access methods for news resources and related entities.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Fetches news resources matching optional filter criteria, returning a flow of a list of populated news resources.

methods.name: getNewsResourceIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of news resources matching optional filter criteria, returning a flow of a list of IDs.

methods.name: upsertNewsResources
methods.description: Inserts or updates a list of news resource entities in the database.

methods.name: insertOrIgnoreTopicCrossRefEntities
methods.description: Inserts a list of news resource-topic cross-reference entities, ignoring conflicts.

methods.name: deleteNewsResources
methods.description: Deletes news resources from the database matching the provided IDs.
